honest_limits: Every number on the page is author-self-run; none is a third-party review. The spot-check record says so explicitly.
The recording is a scripted Playwright session, not a human typing by hand.
Compaction was made to fire early by lowering agent.maxContextTokens for the recording; the value was restored afterwards and no product code was changed for the recording.

The upstream 0/20 is a structural control from a fake summarizer that emits no FACT text, not the ceiling of real summarization; the real-LLM comparison is separate and small (16 questions per cell, 2 seeds, same model as summarizer and judge).
The gain is fidelity to the current task, not memory of abandoned topics; the old-topic advantage is a harness artifact and goes to zero under decorrelated wording.
Hippo costs more post-compaction tokens (about 1.11-1.20x structurally, about +5-24% in the real-LLM records).
